health.logs.event_description.push_outco: A change from this device was accepted by your store.

A change clashed with your store's copy, was re-checked against it, and saved successfully.
The POS sent your queued changes to your store.
A change you made was queued to send to your store.

health.logs.event_description.signal_cyc: The POS checked your store for changes and saved anything new.

health.logs.error_action.PRINT301: Check the printer's power, cable, and network.

health.logs.error_action.LICENSE201: Update the WCPOS and Pro plugins to matching versions.
health.logs.error_action.LICENSE301: Re-authorize the license so updates can download.

health.logs.error_action.PAYMENT999: Confirm whether the payment went through before retrying.
health.logs.error_action.PRINT999: Repeat only the operation named in the log.
health.logs.error_action.PRODUCT999: Try again; report it if it repeats.
health.logs.error_action.LICENSE999: Keep working; re-enter the key or contact support if it persists.
health.logs.error_action.SYNC401: Nothing to do — the task restarts automatically.
health.logs.error_action.SYNC411: Keep working; report it if it keeps happening.

health.logs.error_action.CLIENT111: Wait a moment; reload once if it persists.
health.logs.error_action.CLIENT121: Nothing to do — one tab syncs for all.

health.logs.error_action.AUTH331: Ask the site admin to update the WCPOS plugin on the store.
health.logs.error_action.AUTH411: Check the store address for typos.
health.logs.error_action.AUTH421: Ask your host to let the Authorization header reach WordPress.

health.logs.error_action.HOST101: Ask your host to allow the API's OPTIONS preflight.

health.logs.error_action.HOST121: Ask your host to allow-list the store's API paths.
health.logs.error_action.HOST131: Ask your host to raise the proxy's header limit.
health.logs.error_action.HOST141: Ask your host to allow product-search requests.

health.logs.error_action.HOST161: Ask your host to raise or exempt the API rate limit.

health.logs.error_action.PRINT311: Retry; check the email/SMTP or download settings.
